item.stem:
Triathlon

A triathlon is a race in which athletes swim, then cycle, then run set distances. The first person to complete the whole course is the winner.

Kathy, Barbara, and Sue competed with each other in a triathalon. The course they covered consisted of a 1 kilometer swim, followed by a 40 kilometer cycle ride, and then a 15 kilometer run.

| Triathlon | Kathy | Barbara | Sue |

Who won the triathlon?

The graph represents the distance and time of a hike taken by Joshua and Liam.

[Image: Line graph of distance versus time]

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 2-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (eighth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it. The state also lists reference items: the calibrated TIMSS items of the same grade most similar to this one (never the item itself or its other parts), most similar first, with their percent correct and their calibrated parameters, each on the scale of its own calibration. Use them to place this item.
